tools.description: Tool-name allowlist; * scans every tool result.

on_error.description: Fail closed or open if the contextual scanner cannot decide.

max_scan_bytes.description: Maximum tool-output bytes scanned; zero is unbounded. Oversized results skip inference with block. With allow, a bounded prefix is scanned: findings still withhold the result, but a clean prefix allows the unscanned remainder. Partial scans are never cached as clean.
